methodology: ONE structured-mode synthesis call per question (offline/eval-only, backend/groundedness_eval.py), run deliberately against a small real sample of data/eval_set.json questions with document_ids confirmed present in production ChromaDB at run time. Averages are computed only over questions that actually produced a real (non-NOT_MEASURED) score — a rate-limited or failed call contributes to questions_rate_limited_or_failed, not a fabricated 0.
not_measured: semantic answer correctness beyond keyword overlap (would require either a reference answer + an LLM judge, or human annotation — neither is run here)
